## Direction

After the checkpoint-v3 repair passed exact real-data restart validation and
the project owner reported commit `9ba82bdaf` pushed, the assistant recommended
returning to the empirical FRUIT lane: retain historical Citlali as the eventual
scientific control and define the first candidate-recurrence experiment using
the already accepted scientific and performance dimensions.

The scientific owner replied:

> Pushed. I agree, let's proceed

This direction authorizes preparation of the next owner-review decision. It
does not silently promote the current refactor executable to the exact
historical control and does not by itself authorize a numerical prototype,
algorithm change, reduction, candidate run, tuning, Gate D, qualification,
Stage B, production use, or Unity activity.

## Required Honesty Boundary

The first experiment proposal must distinguish:

- the unavailable exact historical scientific control at source commit
  `f70701ad488444f3e2528c6bbe3e798863c9e301`;
- an exact same-build compatibility control used only to isolate a proposed
  recurrence change; and
- known injected truth used to measure compact-source response.

A preliminary result against the compatibility control may screen a candidate
family. It cannot establish superiority or non-inferiority to historical
Citlali, qualify a method, or close `SCI-FRUIT-ODQ-001`.
